tinyBatchThroughput.selection: Frozen structural tiny panel: trivial, cyclic, noncyclic, and rank-four fields; no timing-based exclusions.

boundary.comparison: Both arms start from the same public monic polynomial. Rust returns and verifies a complete imaginary class-group certificate; PARI flag zero additionally computes the rank-zero unit/regulator data. Projection and process startup are excluded.
